note: Non-urn `directiveId` — HCP directive identifiers are urn:uuid (HCP 6.4).
Missing `accessToken` — the Management Client's token is the evidence of the person's authority.
Missing `directiveId` — a removal names the directive it removes.
Unknown top-level request member — HCP's remove takes no reason or other member (HCP 9.4.15).
A member in the response — HCP answers 204 No Content, so the payload is the empty object.
